effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards in play, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.).
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] Trash 1 digivolution card from the bottom of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
